question: Should OpenAI device-code login use the proposed 30-second per-operation deadline with poll-only retries after the requests are moved onto the canonical guarded OAuth transport?
rationale: The hang requires a deadline, but the exact timeout and retry policy can change authentication behavior for existing users on slow or proxy-mediated networks and is not dictated by the inspected Codex protocol.

options.title: Keep 30 seconds and align transport
options.body: Retain the proposed deadline and poll-only retry behavior, but implement all three calls through the canonical guarded OAuth request lifecycle.

options.title: Choose a different deadline
options.body: Align the transport first, then select and test a different timeout or retry policy for slow-network compatibility.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Leave the current unbounded device-code behavior until the auth-area timeout contract is explicitly designed.

recommendation.title: Keep 30 seconds and align transport
recommendation.body: Retain the proposed deadline and poll-only retry behavior, but implement all three calls through the canonical guarded OAuth request lifecycle.
